title: Pitching an Innovation
grammar: Presenting a technical or creative solution in formal Hungarian register
goal: I can synthesize obligatory participles (-andó/-endő) and formal postpositions (révén, útján, segítségével, céljából, érdekében) in an innovation pitch
I can structure a formal proposal moving from problem diagnosis to prototype validation
I can read and analyze an adapted excerpt from Mór Jókai's Fekete gyémántok
